spark_open.description: A single quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain light background, standing on all four limbs. The body is low and stout with a broad, flat head at the front and a thick fleshy tail extending off the left edge of the image. The dorsal side from the back of the head to the base of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown scales, while the ventral side, head, limbs and tail are pale pink with wrinkled, moist-looking skin. Six feathery pink external gills protrude from the sides of the head behind the eyes, three per side. The head has large golden eyes with dark pupils, small nostrils at the tip of a blunt snout, and dark mottled speckling on the crown. The four limbs are thick and end in five-toed feet with small claws.
